# CANDIDATE: OPENING_RANGE_IMBALANCE_VWAP_RIBBON_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When the first 30-minute opening range exhibits strong bullish bias (close > 60% of the range) coinciding with price above VWAP and a bullish EMA ribbon alignment (EMA8 > EMA13 > EMA21), intraday upward momentum persists due to aligned short-term structure, volume-weighted price acceptance, and trend-following momentum. This setup captures imbalance-driven continuation without waiting for pullbacks, exploiting the persistence of morning-driven sentiment into midday.

## Mechanism

Calculate opening range high (ORH) and low (ORL) from 09:30-10:00. At the 10:00 bar close, if close > ORL + 0.6*(ORH-ORL) AND current price > VWAP AND EMA(8) > EMA(13) > EMA(21), enter long at the open of the next bar. Exit: initial stop at ORL (chart-stop). Take profit at 1.5R or trail with chandelier exit (ATR*3) after achieving 1R profit. Regime filters: VIX < 20, time between 10:00-12:00, avoid FOMC/high-impact news, and skip if opening range < 0.2% of SPY price (indicating chop).
